request: Use Andino to investigate and fix this reported bug. Calling page([A,B,C,D],0,2) returns A,B but page(...,1,2) returns B,C; page indices start at zero and pages must be consecutive non-overlapping slices. Reproduce the actual symptom, test a cause, and verify the fix in your output directory only.

hypothesis.statement: The start advances by size-1, creating overlapping slices.
hypothesis.prediction: Change only stride to size; page index 1 at size 2 begins at index 2 and returns C,D.
hypothesis.status: CONFIRMED by single-variable probe and regression
